conceptZh: 以精巧的木質齒輪連動發條玩具為意象，左側木架化為「木」部，右上雙絲線捲盤轉化為「𢆶」，右下擺錘槓桿卡榫舒展成「戍」，展現「機」關連動的科學趣味。
object: A crafted wooden clockwork marble-run contraption featuring a vertical beam frame on the left, twin brass thread bobbins on the top right, and a mechanical pendulum lever on the bottom right.
morph: A rolling marble triggers a kinetic chain reaction: the wooden beam locks into '木', the spinning bobbins flatten into twin looped strokes '𢆶', and the swinging pendulum lever forms the diagonal and hook strokes of '戍', unifying into the Traditional Chinese glyph '機'.
creativeAngle: 擺脫常見的膠狀物件或直接組裝，改用古樸精細的連動發條與滾珠連鎖反應，將複雜的「機」字拆解為左木、右上雙幺、右下戍的機械結構，既符合字義又富趣味。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D literacy animation for kids on a clean, bright cream background. At 0s, a polished red marble drops into a wooden clockwork toy. From 0s to 2.5s, the marble rolls down a slender wooden beam structure on the left, causing it to snap into the solid strokes of radical '木'. From 2.5s to 5s, the marble hits two golden brass thread bobbins at top-right, which spin into twin looped strokes '𢆶', then triggers a mechanical pendulum lever at bottom-right that swings smoothly to form the strokes of '戍'. The complete assembly fuses perfectly into the single Traditional Chinese character '機' in saturated deep navy blue, filling 70% of frame height with ample clean margins. From 5s to 8s (3 full seconds), the glyph remains strictly centered and static against the bright, clutter-free background. Clear Taiwanese Mandarin audio pronounces 'jī' four times ('jī... jī... jī... jī') with gentle audio-visual clarity.

conceptZh: 一隻逗趣的發條玩具機器人熱情地進行組裝示範。左側木積木堆疊成「木」字部；機器人頂頭射出兩條彈簧線圈化為右上「𢆶」部；隨後機器人太開心用力擺姿勢，腳底彈簧意外彈跳將自己發射出去，機械手臂與支架剛好斜斜卡在右下方形成「戍」部。全體緊密組合成一個深藍色「機」字。過程充滿玩具機器人的滑稽意外與機械趣味。
object: A quirky wind-up toy robot with spring legs, metallic coiled cables, and wooden toy building blocks on a bright pastel background.
morph: The wooden blocks align on the left into radical '木', two coiled spring cables extend at top-right for '𢆶', and the toy robot catapults itself into bottom-right forming '戍', snapping into the complete Traditional Chinese character '機'.
creativeAngle: 響應家長「用機器人生動搞笑」的建議，設計發條玩具機器人因興奮過度被腳底彈簧意外發射的喜劇彈跳，將機械組件與姿態順暢轉化為「機」字的「木、𢆶、戍」結構。語音嚴格遵循「機、機、機器人」格式，畫面純淨無字幕，結尾靜止展示3秒。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D stylized toy animation on a clean, warm light-cream background. At 0s, on the left, rectangular wooden toy blocks stack smoothly to form the strokes of radical '木'. From 1.5s to 3s, a small, boxy wind-up toy robot shoots two golden coiled spring-cables from its head into the top-right area, looping into the strokes of '𢆶'. At 3s, the robot strikes an overly enthusiastic victory pose, but its spring feet recoil unexpectedly, catapulting it backwards; its metallic diagonal arm and lever bracket land perfectly across the bottom-right to form '戍'. At 5s, all parts lock into a single, perfectly proportioned Traditional Chinese character '機' in solid dark navy blue, filling 70% of frame height with generous margins. From 5s to 8s (3 full seconds), the completed glyph '機' remains completely centered and static. A warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks in clear Taiwanese Mandarin: "機、機、機器人". Audio is voice only without text or subtitles on screen.
direction: 用機器人的例子，生動搞笑

conceptZh: 布忍者想躲在「機」的細筆畫後面，相機卻看得一清二楚；最後他才找到右側密集筆畫後的小小藏身處。
object: An original tiny teal felt ninja and one rounded yellow toy camera with a telescoping lens.
morph: Begin with the complete, correctly formed glyph. Its narrow left strokes expose the ninja's failed hiding attempt; a dense stroke junction on the right finally conceals his tiny felt body. The glyph never changes shape.
creativeAngle: 改用完整字形演出躲貓貓，避免前版以零件拼字造成右半部結構混淆。相機鏡頭伸長，輕碰忍者露出的屁股；他竟只遮住眼睛，仍自信滿滿，形成具體笑點。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D animation with a locked frontal camera, a warm cream background, and soft, bright lighting. From the opening frame, display one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph, 「機」, centered, uncropped, and approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Use a faithful standard Taiwanese Traditional Chinese typeface, solid saturated indigo strokes, and clean open counters. Give the glyph slight physical depth without changing its frontal outline. The original lead is a tiny teal felt ninja with visible stitched seams, stubby fabric limbs, a soft mask, and absurd confidence in his hiding skills. His only supporting prop is one rounded yellow toy camera with a telescoping lens. All elements are clearly stylized animated toys.

At the opening, the ninja tiptoes behind the narrow vertical stroke of the left 木 radical, proudly believing himself invisible, while his round felt bottom and both elbows remain plainly visible beside it. Keep his scale small and the glyph readable. From 1.1 to 2.8 seconds, the toy camera beside the glyph slowly extends its lens toward his exposed bottom. Pause just before contact, then give him one gentle poke: he makes a tiny soft hop, turns, and immediately covers his own eyes with both hands, confidently freezing while his entire body remains exposed. Hold this ridiculous hiding pose for a brief beat. From 3.3 to 4.6 seconds, he peeks between his fingers, notices the lens still aimed at him, and scurries behind a sufficiently broad, existing stroke junction in the right-hand 幾 component, finally disappearing completely. The camera retracts its lens and rolls out of frame. Do not move, bend, assemble, or replace any glyph strokes during the action.

From 4.6 through 8.0 seconds, hold the complete indigo 「機」 perfectly still and alone in the centered composition, with every stroke unobstructed. A warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly: 「機、機、相機」. Place the first 「機」 around 0.4 seconds, the second around 1.8 seconds, and 「相機」 around 5.4 seconds during the clear final hold. Use the usual ㄐㄧ reading, natural pauses, and no additional speech. Allow only quiet felt rustles and a soft lens-extension sound beneath the voice. The vocabulary is audio only; the single target glyph is the only on-screen text. Maintain an uncluttered frame without subtitles, logos, watermarks, camera flashes, or flashing effects.
